name: End to end hotel booking flow using valid test data
fullName: MakeMyTrip Hotel Booking - Positive and Negative Scenarios: End to end hotel booking flow using valid test data

steps.name: Given User launches MakeMyTrip application
When User closes the initial login popup
And User navigates to the Hotels section
When User selects destination using valid data from "guest_date.csv"
And User verifies default check-in and check-out dates are populated
And User sets guest configuration to 2 adults and 1 room
And User clicks on the Search button
And User closes any promotional popup if present on the results page
And User selects the first hotel from the hotel cards
And User switches to the new hotel details window
And User clicks on Book This Now button
And User enters guest details using data from "guest_date.csv" on the booking page
And User selects "Yes, secure my trip" option
And User clicks on the Pay Now button
Then Browser should close successfully
